notes.title: The Man Came Around : making it free
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

One year ago, I released The Man Came Around after a long and difficult development as a solo dev. 

It was my first game, I had no previous technical or artistic skills and let me tell you that mistakes were made. A lot of them. But I'm very proud of the final product.

Alas, the sales didnt really pan out and my company,  Pipette Inc, recently had to go bankrupt. I appreciate the support of every person that bought the game or supported the project in any form.

I do retain the rights on my game as a private person, but it just doesnt make sense to try to continue to sell it. 

[b]So, I decided to make the game free.[/b] Probably in one or two weeks.

And to let people enjoy or hate it. I know its an inconvenience for those who paid for it first, but I'm sure you'll understand my point of view.

notes.title: Updates for 14th of October
notes.content:
A quick update for this week end. 

Some bugs were notified to me this week, and fixed pretty quickly. I just pushed an update on windows today, and the mac update will come this week.

Again, I'm annoyed that i didn't catch all of them before release, but I'm dedicated to fix any bug reported to me on the forums as soon as I can!

notes.title: The Man Came Around : Some more fixes
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone ![/b]


Thank you for purchasing the game! Like I said in the last announcement, I'm trying to find and fix every little bugs that could have escaped my gaze before. I pushed a couple of fix during this week, and I'll continue every time it's needed.

I also plan to do some bigger updates. Mainly a french translation in a month or two, but also more dialogues or dangers down the line, to keep it fresh. 


[b]If you encounter a bug during your run, you can email me at pipetteinc (at) gmail (dot) com[/b] 


Try to describe the situation the best you can. Where you were, the action you were trying to do, when and how the game bugged. The more info I have, the easier it will be for me to find it and fix it.

[b]Also, if a dialogue seems to bug during a playthrough, you can press the space bar to skip it instead of being stuck.[/b]

But if you do, telling me where it happened would be very appreciated, so I can fix the line! Screenshots also help a lot!

You can also skip dialogues with the space bar if you're in a hurry ;)

notes.title: The Man Came Around : the game is released! + Bug fixes
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone ![/b]


The game finally launched yesterday. After seven years of work, it's a big relief! I hope you'll enjoy it.


Of course, no release is free of bugs. As a solo dev, catching them all was impossible, even with the help of playtesters, so some may still be there. I'm fully dedicated to fixing them, of course. I already pushed an update with some fixes today based on your feedback. I'll continue to do so in the coming weeks and months.


[b]If you encounter a bug, you can email me at pipetteinc (at) gmail (dot) com[/b] 


Try to describe the situation the best you can. Where you were, the action you were trying to do, when and how the game bugged. The more info I have, the easier it will be for me to find it and fix it.

[b]Also, if a dialogue seems to bug during a playthrough, you can press the space bar to skip it instead of being stuck.[/b]

But if you do, telling me where it happened would be very appreciated, so I can fix the line!

You can also skip dialogues with the space bar if you're in a hurry ;)

[b]Thank you for all of you who purchased the game already, and I hope you'll enjoy it![/b]

notes.title: The Man Came Around Release Date
notes.content:
Hey yall! A quick but important annoucement.

[b]The game will release on August 9th.[/b]

After years of hard work, it's time to get this game across the finish line. Hope you'll enjoy it!
